Class MeshCoreCompanionProtocolRuntime

java.lang.Object
com.meshtastic.client.protocol.meshcore.MeshCoreCompanionProtocolRuntime
All Implemented Interfaces:
ProtocolRuntime<MeshCoreCompanionState>, AutoCloseable
public final class MeshCoreCompanionProtocolRuntime extends Object implements ProtocolRuntime<MeshCoreCompanionState>
Runtime for the MeshCore Companion Protocol.

Runs over BLE RX/TX or a raw TCP/Serial byte stream, sends APP_START, requests device metadata, and stores the assembled state in MeshCoreCompanionState.
